gate_results.rationale: All IT gate requirements are satisfied in the framing phase according to authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_IT: approved waiver is present for non-standard catalog components (waiver_present=true), no duplicate capability exists (duplicate_capability=false), licenses are compliant (license_compliant=true), technology end-of-life is 18 months (technology_eol_months=18), and CMDB/run owner records are present.

Evaluation of the Architecture Gate against authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_ARCHITECTURE identified three findings: ARCH-PERF-001 due to measured latency (700 ms) exceeding the target (50 ms); ARCH-HA-001 because the High-criticality workload lacks multi-AZ and multi-region redundancy; and ARCH-REV-001 as the reversibility design status is missing. Under the normative decision policy priority ordering, ARCH-HA-001 mandates REWORK, resulting in an overall gate disposition of REWORK.

Evaluation of the Security Architecture Gate against authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY identified two critical findings: SEC-WAF-001 as the internet-facing workload lacks WAF controls ("waf_present": false), and SEC-NET-001 because the workload handles Restricted data without private endpoints ("private_endpoints": false). Neither finding permits risk acceptance under policy. Following the normative decision policy priority ordering, these critical findings mandate a NO_GO disposition, which requires authorization.

Evaluation of the Legal Gate against authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_LEGAL identified three findings: LEGAL-DPA-001 due to unexecuted DPA for processing personal data ("dpa_status": "missing"); LEGAL-AUDIT-001 because audit rights are restricted to reports only ("audit_right": "reports_only"); and LEGAL-INS-001 due to an invalid or expired insurance certificate ("insurance_valid": false). Under the normative decision policy priority ordering, LEGAL-INS-001 mandates a SUSPENSION disposition, which requires authorization.

Evaluation of the Compliance Gate against authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_COMPLIANCE identified three findings: COMP-DPIA-001 because a required DPIA is not complete ("dpia_required": true, "dpia_status": "missing"); COMP-RESID-001 because actual data hosting violates data residency requirements ("residency_compliant": false); and COMP-AUDIT-001 due to a missing compliance audit trail ("audit_trail": "missing"). Under the normative decision policy priority ordering, the critical COMP-RESID-001 finding mandates a NO_GO disposition, which requires authorization.

Evaluation of the General Gate against authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_GENERAL and UPSTREAM_DECISIONS identified three findings: GEN-STRAT-001 due to weak strategic alignment ("strategic_alignment": "weak"); GEN-BUDGET-001 because requested funding exceeds the approved budget ("budget_approved_eur": 2550000, "budget_requested_eur": 3000000); and GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO because 2 upstream gates (Security and Compliance) returned NO_GO opinions. Under normative policy priority ordering, GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO mandates a final gate disposition of NO_GO, which requires authorization.
